images.name: Ősi romok
images.scene: A hidden jungle stone-seal altar on a quiet terraced clearing. Low broad stone platform with three steps, THREE clearly distinct carved round discs arranged left-to-right on its top: SUN with a central circle and broad triangular rays; WATER with three wavy parallel lines; LEAF with one simple leaf and stem. Exactly these three discs, no writing/runes or extra discs. Weathered chunky pale-gray blocks, three differently broken square pillars with a few thick vines, broad ferns and fan palms, cool shaded forest. A curved sandy approach and larger flat slate stones distinguish this location. Explorer stands lower-left with one hand resting on a block, inspecting the three discs, rear three-quarter. All altar and explorer readable around center. Simple geometry and carvings, no tiny masonry noise.
